title: When the data lives on more than one machine
question: There are copies of the data on several machines now. What can a read still promise you?
summary: Replication first, because that is where a stale read comes from. Then what CAP actually asks you to choose, and which failure a write's acknowledgement protects you against. No workout fits this one, so the hour ends on reps.

steps.note: The write side of the same question: success, against which failure?
